title: coulteria glabra
intro: Coulteria glabra, commonly known as Coulter's beard, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is a perennial herb native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. Coulteria glabra has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and is also believed to aid in the treatment of various health conditions such as fever and sore throats. The bioactive constituents of Coulteria glabra include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
